name: National Insurance Request For Supporting Documents
summary: Requests payslips, identity records, or other proofs so a benefit claim or insurance status can be decided.

guidance.primaryNextStep: Collect every document listed on the notice and submit them through the named channel before the deadline.
guidance.deadlineSummary: Submit by the date shown on the notice
guidance.appliesWhen: Bituach Leumi cannot finish a claim or status review until you prove something with documents
guidance.recommendedChannel: Use the exact upload, email, fax, or branch channel listed on the request.
guidance.whenToContactAuthority: you cannot get the documents in time or the request names documents that do not fit your case
guidance.whatToVerify: Verify which claim this request belongs to, the exact document list, and the submission deadline.

sections.explainer: Case number and request type — identifies which claim or insurance matter is waiting for evidence. It may relate to unemployment, maternity, residency, or self-employed status.
Requested documents — the exact proofs they need, such as payslips, employer confirmations, passport pages, entry records, or bank statements.
sections.actionRequired: Gather every listed document exactly as named; missing even one item can pause the claim.

sections.explainer: How to submit — tells you whether to upload in the personal area, email the branch, fax, or appear in person. Each channel may need the case number on every page.
sections.actionRequired: Use the submission method named on the notice and keep the confirmation number or screenshot.

sections.explainer: Document deadline — the date by which the branch expects the files. Missing it can freeze the case or lead to a decision without the evidence you wanted considered.
sections.actionRequired: If you cannot gather everything in time, contact the branch before the deadline and ask for an extension.
sections.deadline: Submit by the date shown on the notice

sections.explainer: What happens next — explains whether payment, eligibility review, or case reopening will continue after the documents arrive.
